title: The Hoard in the Hollow
text: A dead king's gold spills across the floor of a hollow tree, coins and crowns and cups, more than any one House could carry. The king himself sits among it, nothing left of him but a grin. You agree to share it. Each House decides, alone in the dark, whether it means to.

options.label: Share it fairly, as you swore you would.

outcomes.text: Every House keeps its word. The gold is divided evenly, and with it a measure of trust.
When you reach for your share, it is gone. Someone did not keep their word.

options.label: Take more than your share. The dead king will hardly miss it.

outcomes.text: No one else thought to do the same. Your packs hang heavy all the way home.
Others had the same idea. Knives come out over the coins before anyone thinks better of it.
